vb_textbox.text: Two sets of gnomes will almost always appear together, one will always pay out more then the other and will stay that way for a few rounds and then switch. Keep focus and if a gnome is not paying out as much as it was before switch. Find a way to remember which one is better like saying something in your head 'green is good' or red over blue. When it switches change what you say so you can try to remember the pattern,
